svg.aria-label: Map of the H100's 132 SMs: the first block of every SM belongs to one of four generation engines; the second block of every other SM belongs to the learner.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: 132 SMs, 2 blocks each (top and bottom half). 198 blocks generate, 66 learn.
